enrichment_method.evidence: MARS Hu-14 immunodepletion: Plasma samples were depleted using the MARS Hu-14 (Agilent) following the manufacturer's protocol.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptide fractionation for spectral library: A “pool” sample composed of the 40 plasma samples was dedicated to obtain a spectral library for the data independent acquisition (DIA) approach. The “pool” sample was depleted and digested as indicated above and peptide fractionation was done using poly(styrene-divinylbenzene) reverse phase sulfonate (SDB-RPS) Stage-Tips method as already described (Rappsilber, Mann, et Ishihama 2007) (Kulak et al. 2014).
